summary: On the main deck the crew watches a screen, transfixed, as Neo attempts his first jump in the Construct. Mouse keeps raising the possibility that Neo might actually succeed, but Apoc and Tank insist it is impossible since no one has ever made their first jump. Trinity says nothing until the end, when she clenches her fists and whispers encouragement, revealing that beneath her certainty she is hoping he makes it.

what_changes.before: Willing to entertain that Neo might succeed where no one has before
what_changes.after: Still hopeful but repeatedly shut down by the others' certainty
what_changes.evidence: MOUSE / What if he makes it? ... MOUSE / I know, but what if he does?

what_changes.before: Silent and watchful, seemingly sharing the group's certainty that Neo will fail
what_changes.after: Commits her hope aloud, whispering 'Come on' as her fists clench
what_changes.evidence: Trinity stares at the screen, her fists clenching as she / whispers. / TRINITY / Come on.

event_hint.one_line: The crew watches Neo's first jump attempt from the main deck, part of their larger effort to prepare him as the One.

uncertain: Whether Trinity genuinely believes Neo will fail or only says 'He won't' through Apoc while secretly hoping otherwise
Whether Neo actually completes the jump, since the scene ends before showing the result
